name: bond-cockpit
description: Cockpit for bond: a status line (branch, PR host, tracker, active gh account, PR checks, prompt-cache hit rate and TTL) and a docked pane with repo, pull request, CI and prompt-cache status plus turn, task and subagent progress, with a toast before the cache expires. A mod of function hooks; needs a Claude Code build with plugin hooks modules.

personalAccount.title: Personal gh account
personalAccount.description: The gh login expected for repos whose origin owner is this account

workAccount.title: Work gh account
workAccount.description: The gh login expected in Bonliva repos

cacheTtl.title: Prompt-cache TTL
cacheTtl.description: 5m or 1h; a model switch overrides it with the TTL it reports

cacheWarnSeconds.title: Cache expiry warning (seconds)
cacheWarnSeconds.description: How long before the cache expires the toast fires; 0 turns it off
